Sahas sabhi gunon mein sabse zaroori hai, kyunki sahas ke bina koi bhi gun lagatar nahi chal sakta.
Grit adig hai.
Shant dimag strong dimag hai.
Body strength nahi—mind strength count karti.
Duniya todti hai, phir bhi kai strong bante.
Courage: afraid hoke bhi wahi karna.
Himmat fear se ladder banati.
Chuppi gehra chintan hai.
Thehraav hi spashtta ki chabi hai.
Grit na rukne wali drive hai.
Shahbaloot ka ped hawa se lada aur toot gaya, beed ka ped jhuka aur bach gaya.
Jahan simplicity, goodness aur truth nahi, wahan greatness nahi hoti.
Strength tab paida hoti jab lagta—bas nahi.
Shaant dimaag ko uljhaya ya daraya nahi ja sakta.
Safalta antim nahi hai, vipalta ghatak nahi hai: aage badhte rehne ka saahas hi maayne rakhta hai.
Darr sirf ek mansik avastha hai.
Sabr aur himmat hi asli taj hai.
